animatedCaptions.title: Yadda Ake Ƙara Rubutun Magana Mai Motsi a ByteWave
animatedCaptions.description: Ƙara rubutu a bidiyonka, zaɓi tasiri mai motsi ka sanya rubutun maganarka a ByteWave. Gajeren jagora don iPhone, iPad da Mac.
animatedCaptions.lead: Ƙara rubutunka a bidiyo ka ba shi tasiri mai motsi.
animatedCaptions.step1: Buɗe bidiyonka a ByteWave ka ƙara rubutun magana.
animatedCaptions.step2: Shigar da rubutunka, sannan ka zaɓi rubutun maganar don gyara salonsa.
animatedCaptions.step3: Zaɓi font, girma da launi. Sanya rubutun a kan bidiyonka.
animatedCaptions.step4: Zaɓi tasirin rubutu, sannan ka kunna bidiyon don ganin samfotin motsin.
animatedCaptions.readabilityText: Yi amfani da gajeriyar jimla da launin da yake fitowa a kan bidiyon. Tabbatar motsin ya bar isasshen lokacin karantawa.
animatedCaptions.relatedTail: yana bayanin tsare-tsare kamar Orbital Letters da Ember Ash.

animateStickers.title: Yadda Ake Sa Lambobi Su Motsa a ByteWave
animateStickers.description: Sa lamba ta motsa a fadin bidiyonka a ByteWave. Yi amfani da lokaci da firam ɗin maɓalli don sauya matsayinta, girmanta da juyawarta.
animateStickers.lead: Yi amfani da firam ɗin maɓalli don motsa lamba, sauya girmanta ko juya ta da tafiyar lokaci.
animateStickers.step1: Ƙara lamba a bidiyonka ka zaɓe ta.
animateStickers.step2: Saita lokacin bayyanarta da maɓallan lokaci.
animateStickers.step3: Yi amfani da maɓallan firam ɗin maɓalli don adana matsayin farko, girma da juyawa.
animateStickers.step4: Je zuwa lokaci na gaba ka sa wani firam ɗin maɓalli mai matsayi, girma ko juyawa daban.
animateStickers.step5: Kunna bidiyon don ganin samfotin motsin da ke tsakaninsu.
animateStickers.readabilityHeading: Fara da firam ɗin maɓalli biyu
animateStickers.readabilityText: Gwada motsa lamba daga gefe ɗaya na firam zuwa ɗaya. Idan ta yi kyau, ƙara canjin girma ko juyawa.
